name: The Queen Anne
description: The Queen Anne's Revenge was a pirate ship formerly known as the Concorde and the Concorde of Nantes. Magnificent, breathtakingly beautiful, a beast of the sea, this legendary ship spread across the seven seas strikes fear into the hearts of pirates on the high seas. Quickly cutting a passage through the open ocean, the Revenge relies on powerful defenses and deadly weapons. The Queen Anne's Revenge is said to have sailed laden with riches and treasures stolen from its unfortunate victims.
